SUPERVISOR — WBCHAR-0606 addendum: deep view-state twigs. Marker: TWIGSTATE-0606, ledger req_0010 (resolve it on landing).

USER ASK, verbatim: "they need to add in workspace twigs to remember exactly what route/panel/state im in so hot reload doesnt take me from painting on a texture to viewing a 3d model."

The twig system exists (editors/twigs.ts, route twigs landed 414469c6f) — extend it DEEP for the workbench: a hot reload (or leave-and-return) restores EXACTLY where the user was: route → source/category → selected roster row → active lens (PAINT vs FIGURE/PART/SCULPT) → the lens's own working target (the part being painted). The named failure, never again: painting on a texture → reload → staring at a 3D model.

Shape: view-state is ephemeral-but-twigged — the Workbench already owns selection/lens state (§2: "owns selection/lens/filter/rev state"); twig those fields per the existing twigs conventions (additive; old twig files unaffected). The PAINT lens's unsaved strokes are ALREADY covered by your workbench-scoped draft slots — this is about the VIEW restoring so those drafts are visible again without navigation. Apply the same depth to any view state your source owns; note in CAPTURE what is twigged vs deliberately not (e.g. transient hover). P4: a twig round-trip test (set state → serialize → restore → identical view fields). Explicit paths, verify green, resolve req_0010 with the paragraph + SHAs. READY when a mid-painting hot reload provably returns the user to the same brush on the same part.
resolution: Same landing as req_0010 (this prompt was the TWIGSTATE-0606 dispatch itself): deep workspace twigs for the workbench — frame source/row/lens twigs, store working-row twig with keepView restore, adapter-injectable twig deps, CAPTURE twigged-vs-transient table, 14/14 P4 green incl. the round-trip test.
